comments.mightyvega: March foal; 19,000gns yearling; from the first crop of Lucky Vega; likely type

comments.normanscay: March foal; £60,000 yearling; notable connections landed this prize in 2022; respected

races.raceComment: justicetwice is marginally preferred with a score of 12.2%. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.jamessdelight: Major improver over 6f as 3yo, close 2nd to Spycatcher in French Group 3; more to come
comments.marshman: Very good 2nd in this race last year; in fine form on AW at 6f and 5f; solid chance
comments.perfectpart: Won 5f debut as 2yo; needs to have improved plenty to take a hand on these terms

comments.spycatcher: High-class sprinter at 6f; tends to reproduce his best form on reappearance; solid chance
comments.witnessstand: Good progress over 7f as 3yo; well held at Riyadh on yard debut; first 6f run since 2yo

verdict.comment: Botanical appeals as one who will do well for George Boughey in 2025 but narrow preference is for the same owner's LIBERTY LANE.

comments.botanical: Ended 2024 with near miss in 1m2f Listed for new yard; bold show likely back from wind op
comments.checkandchallenge: Placed in Group/Listed last summer but ended 2024 on low note; minus headgear on return
comments.chiccolombine: French Listed win last March; more miss than hit after; has had wind op; now tongue tied
comments.dancinggemini: Below par at end of 2024 but went close in French 2,000 Guineas on last year's return
comments.libertylane: Won the Cambridgeshire and second in Group 3 on final two runs at 4; big player
comments.nobleorder: Changed hands for only 1,500gns ahead of this stable debut; big outsider
comments.pointlynas: Made all in 1m Listed race last July; not seen again until second in Qatar last month
comments.savvyvictory: Turf Listed winner who landed good AW handicap in December (both 1m2f); opposable at 1m
comments.witchhunter: Hold-up performer who ran well for second in 7f AW Listed race three weeks ago

races.raceComment: botanical is marginally preferred with a score of 52.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings over chiccolombine. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 3 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 3/9 at doncaster. Key attributes include positive comments, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having been the only runner to threaten a Godolphin hotpot in a big-field handicap at Meydan last month, SEAN (nap) earns the vote.

comments.alphacrucis: Two heavy-ground wins at Goodwood last autumn; may need testing ground to make an impact
comments.apiarist: Has thrived on AW this winter; needs to transfer improvement back to turf (1-12 on grass)
comments.beringer: Well handicapped on old form but this 10yo returns from another absence with lots to prove
comments.dashingdarcey: Consistent and progressive for Roger Varian last year; career best needed on stable debut
comments.dualidentity: Good campaign last season; should be suited by strongly run race at this trip; e-w claims
comments.fantasticfox: Suspicion he's best on AW but some pretty good turf form last year; each-way possibilities
comments.galeron: Fourth in 2,000 Guineas in 2023; back with this yard after going 0-12 in Australia
comments.godwinson: Lightly raced 5yo who goes well fresh and his trainer has won this four times
comments.lattam: Runner-up in this last year on reappearance; his best turf form is on soft going
comments.magnumopus: In top form at Meydan the last twice with this visor back on; could have a part to play
comments.midnightgun: Progressive campaign last season and this lightly raced 4yo could still have more to offer
comments.mrprofessor: Won this 12 months ago; down the field on next three starts but he's not written off
comments.nativewarrior: Ran well at top summer meetings last year and this 4yo retains considerable potential
comments.oldcock: 4yo who has won three of his six races and is open to further improvement this year
comments.olivershow: Listed runner-up in Bahrain three weeks ago and he's in with a chance
comments.orandi: Won 27-runner Irish Lincolnshire a fortnight ago and could be involved under 5lb penalty
comments.orne: Poor end to last season and best form is at 6f, but in top hands and dangerous to discount
comments.sean: Second of 16 in Meydan handicap two starts ago and that form entitles him to respect
comments.thunderrun: Three wins from his six starts; may well evolve into something better than a handicapper
comments.toimyson: Enjoyed very solid handicap campaign last term (won Golden Mile) and he's an e-w player
comments.twotempting: Five wins last year; this 6yo needs to be better than ever today but is not ruled out
comments.whipcracker: Well backed when close fourth on AW return; lightly raced and could be capable of better

races.raceComment: apiarist is marginally preferred with a score of 47.9%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over magnumopus. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Soft ground from 8 attempts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The AW doesn't work for LIFE ON THE ROCKS but his turf mark has fallen in tandem with his AW one and he's interesting back on grass.

comments.aimforthemoon: Won on first 1m2f attempt; has not gone on from that and slow starts can be an issue
comments.annexation: Latest win over 1m1f at Gowran last spring; hasn't been  cracking it on AW for new yard
comments.arcticfox: Mixed results since two Haydock wins in summer 2022; up against it on first run since July
comments.bashful: Four Flat wins in 2023; subsequent wins hurdling, latest two in February; favourable mark
comments.bizarrelaw: Long spell of modest results for two yards; of more interest when the ground dries out
comments.bookoflife: Both wins on AW; 0-12 on turf but this first attempt at 1m2f on grass might work for him
comments.bulldogspirit: Winner of his only course start; back to form with 1m3f AW win on yard debut last week
comments.destinado: Eight wins last year included one over C&D; considered now below latest winning turf mark
comments.freddyrobinson: Broke Flat duck over 1m2f (good to soft) last June; fit from hurdling; weights chance
comments.kalikapour: Both wins on AW, 0-9 on turf; didn't stay 1m6f for new yard latest; up against it here too
comments.lifeontherocks: Winless on AW over the winter; now 12lb lower than when successful on latest turf run
comments.marioento: Lacks turf experience but improved to win latest AW start (extended 1m1f); should progress
comments.monteria: Good mark on past 1m2f form; not his old self in 2024; well held on recent hurdle debut
comments.muhib: Two fair 1m2f runs in AW handicaps for this yard; may yet improve back on turf
comments.quickaway: Two AW wins this year at about 1m but stamina for this greater test is suspect
comments.rockarmour: Matched best form when 1m2f winner at Newcastle in February; more to prove back on turf
comments.stoicsyd: Two AW wins at 1m in 2024 but a weak finisher beyond that sort of trip and 5lb wrong today
comments.waistcoat: Maiden; minor handicap form for both yards and stamina is far from assured over new trip
comments.whatacracker: Lightly raced since wide-margin 1m3f win in 2023; beaten fair way out on AW comeback

races.raceComment: freddyrobinson is marginally preferred with a score of 52.5%, holding clear edges in more progressive over lifeontherocks. Placed in 4 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.chillhi: Has generally struggled on the Flat and over hurdles since last May
comments.corsicancaper: No significant impact on AW lately but won on turf off 8lb higher last autumn
comments.distinction: Three turf wins last summer but recent AW form has been respectable at best
comments.kingmont: AW maiden win last spring but has found it tougher in handicaps since
comments.laserfocus: Struggled on AW lately but he's better on turf; could revive
comments.letmeseethecolts: 1m3f AW win in January; fair third latest; should go well back on turf
comments.minersgamble: Placed over C&D last autumn and third in two recent hurdle races; should be competitive
comments.nightbear: Arrives in form from AW and 1lb below the mark he defied at Brighton last summer
comments.phonetag: AW win in January; freshened up since lesser run later that month; turf winner
comments.powerfulresponse: Ended 2024 with two close calls over 1m2f at Newcastle but well held both starts this year
comments.rainwater: In consistent form on AW this winter; just as good on turf; likely to go well again
comments.rightnow: Decent Flat form earlier in career but well held in two recent hurdle runs for new yard
comments.runofluck: Did well in turf handicaps last autumn; unexposed 4yo; player if fully primed
comments.seeparis: Struggled on AW lately; change of stable and return to turf need to spark a revival
comments.sisterandbrother: First AW win in January but below par twice since
comments.straya: Unplaced in all 13 starts, so needs improvement from somewhere back from 156 days off
comments.theganges: All four starts AW, finishing well held on handicap debut in November; can only be watched
comments.youngfire: Struggled on AW this year but now 10lb below the mark he defied on turf last autumn

verdict.comment: Maggies Boy is feared but if TROPICAL SPEED is to win a race it will be at this lowly level under these conditions.

comments.arcticsaint: Has placed form and it wasn't a bad run after wind surgery at Chepstow
comments.boskillborden: Well beaten on UK debut but at 2m and he did place over 2m6f in Ireland
comments.caballodiablo: Has achieved little under rules and not ideal that he's 4lb wrong at the weights
comments.calagogo: Form for Gordon Elliott is a fading memory; an okay run three starts ago but poor since
comments.dublintomilan: Still relatively early days but significant improvement is required
comments.kaproyale: Quiet stable debut but will at least enjoy these conditions and he does have track form
comments.maggiesboy: Runner-up on handicap debut at Sedgefield (2m4f, good) and he's bred for this longer trip
comments.mylouise: Dual bumper winner who goes handicapping at a low level and needs checking in the betting
comments.nowyouvebinandunit: 11-race maiden but chased home the favourite over C&D 19 days ago
comments.raystheone: No hurdle win since 2022 and struggles to follow one good run with another
comments.tedsfriend: His struggles continued when a well-held fourth at Southwell on Thursday
comments.tiptoptonto: Has won off 4lb higher but nothing positive to take out of his last four races
comments.topdrawer: Longstanding maiden who has been off for a long time and he's 8lb out of the weights
comments.tropicalspeed: Quiet in two runs for this yard but returning to drier ground could make a big difference

races.raceComment: kaproyale is strongly preferred with a score of 59.5%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over tiptoptonto. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 12 wins from 26 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 12/26 at stratford. Key attributes include optimal distance and strong course form and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Kamboo is a dark horse to note but stamina is going to be a strength for WHO'S GLEN (nap) who gets the vote.

comments.alrazeen: Clearcut C&D win in February for hat-trick under L Morris; could bounce back from last run
comments.coolparty: C&D double last autumn; a notch below best last three starts; 1lb below last winning mark
comments.goldenrules: Just two runs in more than three years with this yard but they were career bests in 2023
comments.jabbar: A rare disappointment last time; never better than Dundalk win (2m, Polytrack) time before
comments.kamboo: Dark horse reappearing at 2m but his family and style of Newcastle 2m AW win give hope
comments.metier: Easily best known for his exploits on soft/heavy; sole AW race when last over C&D in 2023
comments.tritonic: 8yo; creditable fifth in this race last year after another winter break; 5lb lower today
comments.whosglen: Progressive on Tapeta (unraced on Polytrack) before two encouraging 1m6f runs on turf
comments.youthfulking: Some positives but peak AW efforts are at Lingfield and he's never raced beyond 1m4f

races.raceComment: coolparty is marginally preferred with a score of 62.4%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over alrazeen. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 2 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 6/22 at kempton. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Aramram is a key player on his reappearance but HABOOBA had excuses on her return and can resume her progress from a handy draw.

comments.albarez: C&D winner who goes well fresh and is on a winning mark; stall 12 the main concern
comments.amazoniandream: C&D win in December off 1lb lower; solid 3rd when last seen; Oisin Murphy knows him well
comments.aramram: On the up last autumn before a poor run on heavy; has the potential for better this year
comments.ararat: Three 7f wins for D Simcock; sold 35,000gns last October; tricky draw for prominent racer
comments.cajetan: C&D winner; not at best since emphatic Newcastle win in December but had an excuse latest
comments.changesings: Flawless record at the track but absent for 293 days and he'll need a career best to win
comments.habooba: Progressive last year and conditions suit; had an excuse on her return; not fully exposed
comments.harrydid: Made all to win at Newcastle (6f; form franked) this month; good mark but up two grades
comments.monsieurbeaulieu: Two Lingfield wins at a lower level this winter; in good form but no margin for error
comments.rohaan: Retains ability and finished 2nd on latest run; he'll need a good pace around here though
comments.tigercrusade: Retains ability but might find some of his younger rivals having his measure this time
comments.walbank: Only ran to form in one of four runs in Bahrain this winter; reduced mark back in Britain

races.raceComment: habooba is marginally preferred with a score of 57.2%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over amazoniandream. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.bertieb: Seventh and pulled up last two starts; bit to prove all of a sudden
comments.clondawroyale: Holding form well, third at Catterick last month, and in the mix again
comments.copshilllad: Hasn't built on Stratford win, fading when fifth at Wincanton last time; needs more
comments.doubleclick: Arrives in good form in the mud; today's forecast faster ground a possible concern
comments.getawaydrumlee: Poor over fences last time but could have untapped potential over this longer trip
comments.itsmaisy: As good as ever when third in December and excuses since; best efforts on soft ground
comments.juanbermudez: Seems out of sorts and best watched unless there's a market move in his favour
comments.kaitunariver: Has gone backwards since good second over fences at Southwell; cheekpieces fitted
comments.mahland: Well beaten both starts this term and needs to have been revived by recent wind surgery
comments.martybyrde: Off since novice hurdle win in March 2023; carries risks but may still be unexposed
comments.paddyomahler: Comes here after a win and a creditable fourth but drying ground might be a concern
comments.partybusiness: Fifth last time was step back in right direction; longer trip a plus; high on the list
comments.riskdargent: Yet to win a handicap and disappointing from a career-low mark last time
comments.superiorglance: Lightly raced 10yo; third of five at Bangor four weeks ago; impossible to discount

races.raceComment: doubleclick is marginally preferred with a score of 56.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over getawaydrumlee. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Hereford second and third Emerald Warrior and Donttellyamumjack are respected but the vote goes to newcomer DOUBLE MEASURE.

comments.barrowhilllad: Bred to be suited by longer trips in due course and yard has modest strike-rate in bumpers
comments.donttellyamumjack: Promising third at Hereford, finishing with a rare rattle; open to plenty of improvement
comments.doublemeasure: Appealing on pedigree and represents yard with a fine strike-rate in bumpers this term
comments.drivingmissdazy: Will probably be suited by longer distances in time, but not without hope on debut
comments.emeraldwarrior: Attracted support and shaped well when second at Hereford; clearly held in some regard
comments.gaelicglow: 2024's winning stable having good season with bumper runners; well worth a market check
comments.heavencanwait: 20,000gns 2yo; dam useful French Flat winner; trainer can ready one first time
comments.minimario: Stable 0-8 in bumpers this season and others appeal a bit more on paper
comments.mrjukebox: Yard's strike-rate in bumpers has decreased in recent years; this one still needs a look
comments.nightburlesque: Beaten 12l at Catterick (25-1) on debut, fading; may come on for the run
comments.saffroncreed: Half-brother to two sprint winners; others appeal more on pedigree
comments.thebluesmaster: Stable has had excellent season with bumper runners; one of the most interesting newcomers
comments.treadcarefully: Has a plausible pedigree for a race of this nature and the yard wins its share of them
comments.walkinthewest: Second favourite for Listed event at Cheltenham on debut; well beaten but should improve

verdict.comment: In the hope that a wind operation has had a positive effect it may be worth chancing top-weight TWELFTH KNIGHT off a much reduced mark.

comments.bellagioman: Conditions to suit and on a feasible mark; none too consistent but the return to 6f a +
comments.brianthesnail: Claims on this winter's best but he can lose his chance at the start
comments.jimmyknocker: Beat Oriental Prince over C&D in January and 7lb better off today; gone backwards since
comments.justtenhigh: Rare blip at Chelmsford last time but earlier C&D 2nds bring him right into the reckoning
comments.kingscrown: Comes here in good form and eased in grade today; others still more appealing for the win
comments.ladycelia: C&D winner who can go well fresh; not much room for error off current mark though
comments.matchplay: Eyecatching run over 5f here last month; step up to 6f hasn't helped the last twice
comments.nazca: Conditions to suit but little to shout about since his C&D win one year ago
comments.orientalprince: Progressive sprinter; gained first 6f win at Southwell two weeks ago; high on the list
comments.pockley: Has his quirks but he comes here at the top of his game; should be involved again
comments.sirmaxi: Two wins in amateur races this year, including C&D; needs a good pace at the trip
comments.twelfthknight: Struggled on the whole in 2024 but on a dangerous mark if a wind op has the desired effect

races.raceComment: justtenhigh is marginally preferred with a score of 56.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and superior course form over sirmaxi. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 12 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 4/15 at newcastle. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
